item.title: How to Exist
item.description:
📝 By “be content,” I mean be completely okay with your experience of doing nothing. Existence without doing is brutal. When you’re ready, breathe in while keeping the body supple like that.
🔗 Read more: https://www.raptitude.com/2026/07/how-to-exist/

item.title: Show HN: I worked on a new browser for 2 years, today it passed Acid 3
item.description:
📝 cwbrowser A web browser with a rendering engine written completely from scratch in Zig, paired with Google’s V8 for JavaScript. What it is cwbrowser is a desktop web browser built on a rendering engine I wrote from nothing over the last two years. Why build a browser from scratch.
🔗 Read more: https://code.intellios.ai/cwbrowser/
